items.description: Cleaning of affected floor areas in the utility room and adjoining hallway
items.rationale: Covered as cleaning of surfaces affected by the insured escape of water event (7.1.7(h), 7.1.5); reference cases 36 and 59 show this line is indemnified at about 100–110 per room, so for both rooms together t ≈ 210.

items.description: Inspection of the washing machine and supply/drain connection to confirm no further leakage
items.rationale: Covered as necessary investigation to confirm the source and cessation of the leak (7.1.7(e)); reference cases 36 and 59 show t per pc ≈ 147 (range 122–180).

items.description: Removal and disposal of water-damaged skirting boards
items.rationale: Covered as removal/disposal of affected building components (7.1.7(a)); reference cases 36 and 59 show t per pc ≈ 71 (range 31–92).
Covered as reinstatement of affected building components (7.1.7(c)); reference cases 36 and 59 show t per pc ≈ 48 (range 32–115), but for a single unit likely at the lower end.

items.description: Moisture measurement of the utility room and hallway floor
items.rationale: Covered as necessary technical measurement to establish extent of damage (7.1.7(b)); reference case 36 shows t per pc ≈ 126 (range 92–192).

items.description: Drying of the affected floor area
items.rationale: Covered as necessary drying of affected area (7.1.7(b)); reference cases 36 and 59 show t per pc ≈ 239 (range 205–280).
Covered as equipment hire necessary for drying (7.1.7(b)); reference case 36 shows t per pc ≈ 71 (range 51–109).
Covered as necessary labour for repair (7.1.7(g)); reference cases show t for 4 hrs ≈ 304 (range 195–435).

items.description: Transport of the high-value painting to the specialist restorer
items.rationale: NOT indemnified: reference cases 36 and 59 show this line is always t = 0 (not indemnified under 5.2.6, as the cap applies to all measures together and this line is below the lowest proven threshold).

items.description: Professional assessment of the high-value painting
items.rationale: NOT indemnified: reference cases 36 and 59 show this line is always t = 0 (not indemnified under 5.2.6, as the cap applies to all measures together and this line is below the lowest proven threshold).

items.description: Conservatory drying and stabilisation of the painting
items.rationale: NOT indemnified: reference cases 36 and 59 show this line is always t = 0 (not indemnified under 5.2.6, as the cap applies to all measures together and this line is below the lowest proven threshold).
Indemnified as restoration of an individual item of particular value affected by the insured event (5.2.6); reference cases 36 and 59 show t per pc ≈ 1262 (range 1033–1658).
